name: opencode-kartograph
description: OpenCode plugin: Explore a person's intent into intents/<date>-<slug>.md, extract its concepts into an Open Knowledge Format bundle at knowledge/, derive capabilities and Gherkin features under features/, build their screens UI-first on mocked data in a Kotlin Multiplatform app, plan and then make them real with double-loop TDD down to database, API and server, and walk the person through what was built.
author: Tobias Wissmüller <tobias@wissmueller.net>
